Senses.Explanation: Proper indeed, most proper — Xuansha's doubled grant to Lingyun's peach-blossom awakening, followed at once by the guarantee that the old brother is not through; nine centuries of masters have aimed the same doubling at every correct answer in the book. The origin, as raised by Yuanwu Keqin. Lingyun Zhiqin's verse on seeing the blossoms: thirty years a seeker of the sword; how many times the leaves fell and the branches sprouted again; since the one sight of peach blossoms, down to this day, no more doubt. Xuansha Shibei: proper indeed, most proper — yet I guarantee, old brother, you are not through. Says Yuanwu: a thousand-pound bow does not loose its trigger for a gnat. Lingyun had already pulled open the pivot of heaven; Xuansha then overturned the axis of earth. Tell me — which is the not-through place? Let one with the eye that passes the barrier try to discern it. Gaofeng Yuanmiao interleaves his own three-word glosses into the raising: Lingyun's awakening at the peach blossoms — a skull cracked into the glue-basin. Guishan Lingyou's word, entering by condition never to fall back — teeth clenched, sealing Yong Chi. Xuansha's word, proper indeed most proper, I guarantee the old brother is not through — tears shed, beheading Duke Ding. Clever fellow! Even if you see it right here — buy straw sandals and travel thirty more years, then come back and take Xifeng's painful staff. And Chushi Fanqi, raising the same with Dahui's comment already in line — one household's trouble, a hundred households busied — gives his own: without far thought, near sorrow is sure. Even hundred-refined gold cannot escape the furnace for another smelting. Miyun Yuanwu, picking up the same case and Dahui's busied hundred households: what talk of one household's trouble and a hundred households busied — it is one blind man leading a crowd of blind. And Poshan Haiming, after the raised verse with its single-flip — from the one sight of peach blossoms, only down to today no more doubt — hears Xuansha's doubled verdict and appraises: a film in the eye, flowers falling in empty sky; had Xuansha not wielded the golden scalpel well, the man would all but have gone blind. His ode: fragrance fills the branch-tips, blossoms fill the stream; Lingyun's one sight, a clap of hands in light requital. Ha! Who knew there was still a guest in the peach orchard, not letting the spring wind slip past both eyes. Shiqi Tongyun aims the doubled verdict at the whole arsenal, at the bath-master's seat: Deshan blowing out the paper lamp at Longtan, Linji's three painful staves of Huangbo, the cypress tree in the yard, the dried shit-stick, three pounds of hemp — proper indeed, most proper, I guarantee the old brother is not through. And the four shone-uses and four selectings, guest-within-host and host-within-guest, shift upon shift, all landing free — to lift is to lift, to set is to set: what is hard in that? Only the one who cannot put down a single thread asks how the school's matter goes and how to pass through sound and sight. And Jiqi Hongchu, at the close of the Great-Compassion retreat: the Bodhisattva of what is heard advanced first in rites and music, then advanced in rites and music — grasses and trees bow their heads, earth and stone thereupon give light. But let the makara fish one morning bore through the pure precious eye, let Mount Sumeru crush down the matrix-undoing arm: thirty-two responses, fourteen fearslessnesses — proper indeed, most proper, I guarantee the old brother is not through. There is a fellow: raising his brows, fish and dragons gain their way of swimming; in a blink, ghosts and gods have no road to walk — knife-mountains broken down without Manjusri's wondrous wisdom, hells extinguished without Samantabhadra's sameness. Such is the everywhere-roundness of the way-nature, such the deep stillness of the mind-source. If today it is not verified, how will you go on afterward? Palms together: the present can be tested.
